# Copilot Instructions for Prompt Generator

<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

## Project Overview
This is a React-based prompt generator application built with Vite and TypeScript. The application helps users create various types of prompts for AI, coding, creative writing, and other purposes.

## Code Style Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all React components and utilities
- Follow React functional component patterns with hooks
- Use modern CSS with CSS modules or styled-components for styling
- Implement responsive design principles
- Use semantic HTML elements
- Follow accessibility best practices

## Component Structure
- Keep components focused and single-purpose
- Use TypeScript interfaces for prop definitions
- Implement proper error handling and loading states
- Use React hooks appropriately (useState, useEffect, etc.)

## Features to Implement
- Multiple prompt categories (AI, coding, creative writing, business, etc.)
- Template-based prompt generation
- Customizable parameters and variables
- Copy-to-clipboard functionality
- Save/load prompt templates
- Export functionality
- Modern, intuitive user interface

## Dependencies and Tools
- React 18+ with TypeScript
- Vite for build tooling
- Modern CSS for styling
- ESLint and Prettier for code quality
